name: Berkeley Summer 2017

venue.name: 145 Dwinelle / Anna Head Alumnae Hall
venue.address: Anna Head Alumnae Hall, 2537 Haste St, Berkeley, CA 94720
venue.details: The Saturday venue will be **145 Dwinelle**. Sunday will be held in **Anna Head Alumnae Hall**.

information: * This will be Berkeley's first full-on two day competition. Registration is capped at 220 people; there will be no walk-on competitors under any circumstances. * **The Saturday venue will be 145 Dwinelle.** * Saturday has the following events: 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Fewest Moves (best of 1), Megaminx, and Square-1. * **The Sunday venue is Anna Head Alumnae Hall**, on the south side of campus. * Sunday has the following events: 3x3, 3x3 One-Handed, 2x2, and Skewb. * Please read the information tabs on this website for crucial information. * Food is prohibited in the venue.
